_comment: Makes the gated-download gate real rather than cosmetic.
/content/dam/mysite/gated is denied to everyone, so a visitor who guesses or is sent a
gated asset's URL gets a 404 instead of the file. The only route to it is
GatedDownloadServlet, which reads it through the aerovance-gated-download service user.
That service user is granted jcr:read on the gated folder and nothing else. If the
servlet is ever tricked into taking an arbitrary path, the worst it can reach is a
folder whose entire contents it was already allowed to serve.
The deny must come after the allow: repoinit applies these in order, and a deny for
everyone that precedes the service-user grant would be re-broadened by it.
scripts: create service user aerovance-gated-download with path system/mysite

set ACL for aerovance-gated-download
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam/mysite/gated
end

set ACL for everyone
  deny jcr:read on /content/dam/mysite/gated
end
